displayName: OCI-WSTG07-014: GraphQL Injection and Introspection Abuse
description:
Detects GraphQL injection, excessive introspection queries, and depth-based DoS attacks

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg07_014", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%graphql%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%injection%') AND "value" > 0
